PARAMS = {
    "gmid_b":  (14.0, 10.0, 20.0),   # ref + output-bottom nfet gm/Id (Vdsat ~ 2/gm_Id)
    "L_b":     (2.0, 0.5, 4.0),      # bottom length: sets ro/Va and matching
    "gmid_c":  (18.0, 12.0, 22.0),   # cascode nfet gm/Id (low Vdsat -> low compliance)
    "L_c":     (1.0, 0.5, 4.0),      # cascode and bias-diode length
    "gmid_bd": (6.0, 3.0, 12.0),     # bias diode gm/Id: sets Vov_bd -> cascode gate vb
    "I_R":     (5e-6, 2e-6, 20e-6),  # current in the R-fed bias branch
}

VDD_NOM = 1.8

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I_in, I_out, VO = spec["iin"], spec["iout_target"], spec["vout_nom"]

    # 1) Reference: iin is ideal, so the diode-connected M_r forces the common gate vg = Vgs(I_in).
    op_r = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["L_b"], I_in, vds=0.6, vsb=0.0)
    vg = op_r.vgs

    # 2) Bias branch: VDD -> R_b -> diode M_bd sets cascode gate vb = Vgs_bd.
    op_bd = lut.size("n", p["gmid_bd"], p["L_c"], p["I_R"], vds=0.6, vsb=0.0)
    vb = op_bd.vgs
    R_b = (VDD_NOM - vb) / p["I_R"]

    # 3) Output cascode: source node n2 = vb - Vgs_c(Vsb=n2). Iterate once for body effect.
    op_c = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["L_c"], I_out, vds=0.5, vsb=0.1)
    n2 = vb - op_c.vgs
    op_c = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["L_c"], I_out, vds=VO - n2, vsb=n2)
    n2 = vb - op_c.vgs

    # 4) Output bottom: same gate net vg as the reference, but Vds = n2 (not Vgs).
    #    Trim W so that Id(vg, Vds=n2) = I_out, which cancels the Vds mismatch at nominal.
    W0 = op_r.W * I_out / I_in
    Id0 = lut.op("n", W0, p["L_b"], vg, n2, vsb=0.0)["Id"]
    W_ob = W0 * I_out / Id0
    ob = lut.op("n", W_ob, p["L_b"], vg, n2, vsb=0.0)

    # Netlist
    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    n.dev("M_r", "iin", "iin", "vss", "vss", op_r)                    # reference diode, carries iin
    n.M("M_ob", "nx", "iin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W_ob, p["L_b"])    # output bottom, ratio via W
    n.dev("M_oc", "iout", "vb", "nx", "vss", op_c)                    # output cascode
    n.dev("M_bd", "vb", "vb", "vss", "vss", op_bd)                    # bias diode
    n.R("R_b", "vdd", "vb", R_b)                                      # sets bias-branch current

    # First-order predictions (nominal tt/27C/1.8 V)
    rout = (op_c.gm + op_c.gmbs) / (op_c.gds * ob["gds"])             # gm*ro_c*ro_b
    v_compliance = n2 + op_c.vdsat                                    # min Vout for saturation
    iout_err_pct = 100.0 * (ob["Id"] - I_out) / I_out
    power = VDD_NOM * p["I_R"]

    return n, {
        "iout_err_pct": iout_err_pct,
        "rout": rout,
        "v_compliance": v_compliance,
        "power": power,
    }
